positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Work on various projects and products such as lead for configuration portion of new product.
Design - including UX and backend APIs, design documentation / discussions / reviews, PM requirement reviews
Stories / task breakdown and estimation. 
Lead a team of distributed engineers, providing them with guidance, removing roadblocks, code reviews, best practices and division of work while also actively implementing necessary features.
Coordination with other leads to handle interdependencies between services.

Work on various projects and products such as the proxy implementation. Lead for the cloud based proxy agent which is responsible for policy propagation, status and docker deployments.
Enabled team members to accomplish their work by providing guidance and removing obstacles.
Research different approaches and provide recommendations to architecture team.
positions.insights: Skills: User Experience (UX) · Product Management · JavaScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Configuration Management · Front-End Development · Project Planning · Mentoring · Design · Databases · Software Implementation · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · Hybrid Cloud · Front-End Design · Team Lead · Java · Code Review · Full-Stack Development · Unix · GitHub

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead on multiple projects, including leading a team of 8 engineers, all new on product to complete year long project to integrate key features from an older firewall into new product.
Fullstack developer - worked on Java frontend including working with UX team on design. Worked on Java backend including debugging multithreaded system to upload policy to multiple FWs, REST API implementation, database operations
Worked on special customer projects - working with sales engineering and customers to demonstrate product capabilities and provide custom scripts and features.
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Front-End Development · Project Planning · Design · Databases · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Bash · Java · Full-Stack Development · GitHub · Project Management · User Interface Design

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack developer responsible for introducing secondary IPS transaction storage using Lucene Solr in order to make dashboard and report data much quicker to load.  10 minute reports on millions of records were brought down to 1 minute.
Completed FIPS 140-2 after layoff of team-members.
During this time I was promoted from Senior Engineer to Principal Engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: Project Planning · FIPS 140-2 · Databases · Software Implementation · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Full-Stack Development · C# · Solr

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for UI and backend support for various firewall management consoles. Work on standalone UIs (management of one firewall) and Control Centers which allowed management of hundreds of firewalls. Responsible for leading and designing various features throughout the years. Responsible for working with government customers with sensitive data.
During this time I was promoted from Engineer to Senior Engineer.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Databases · Software Development · Python (Programming Language) · Java · Full-Stack Development · Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP) · C# · Unix

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Responsible for test automation framework for E2E firewall testing - configure -> pass traffic -> verify logging.
Transitioned to the dev team: Worked on Web UI for new firewall product.
